limitations: Initial qualification only:8 CPU/8 CUDA cases and32 independent fields;7 coarse physical geometry assets. Test-signature formatting is verified by whole-module AST equality. The first spherical sweep is unconverged and includes duplicate mesh levels. Failed bootstrap, meshing and contact attempts are retained. Contact-blocks-v1 was explicitly cancelled for the Python callback/GIL problem; its closure was checked after cancellation before changing code. The full load-model, convergence and coupled deformable-contact stage is unfinished. Live finer/contact trials are excluded. JSON files above200MB are preserved as exact ordered32MiB byte ranges, individually gzip-compressed, with original/part/stored SHA256 and offsets. Join decompressed ranges in index order to restore the original JSON exactly; no records are reduced or excluded. Runtime staging uses hard links for unchanged small originals.
